text:
rachel_sourcing: Heads-up — Polar Freight emailed: H100 tranche delayed +21d. They propose a 'split-handshake' RMA: 1) urgent 3-unit air bridge, 2) consolidated sea AWB for the rest to reduce brokerage. They want a single signed RMA doc to enable the discount.

miguel_ops: 3 units by air would buy us ~7–10 days if we rejigger non-critical pods. Which region do we prioritize? EU or APAC?

rachel_sourcing: Prioritize eu-west reserved lanes first — latency pods. APAC can tolerate the extra week if we reshuffle capacity.

anya_sre: Operational caveat: if legs arrive separately we must map incoming serials to existing node-tags to avoid duplicate nodes. Need per-leg manifest + photo evidence. I'll add a small provisioning remap hook.

polar_bot: Polar Freight: Confirmed ETA shift +21 days. Offer: 40% off expedite fee for 3-unit air sub-batch if consolidated RMA signed for sea leg. AWB for consolidated sea: POLAR-AWB-7733. HS Code: 85423100. RMA ref: POL-R-7733.

claire_logistics: That sounds fine. How much courier for 3 units air? Fast-forwarder quote ~€680. Vendor expedite baseline €8,200. With 40% discount expedite -> €4,920 + courier €680 = €5,600.

ben_fin: Finance emergency cap = €4,500. Can Polar split the courier or increase discount? If vendor covers 30% courier we drop to ~€5,400, still above. Need vendor to push further or we escalate.

polar_bot: Polar Freight: We can cover 50% of courier for the air-leg if Redwood signs consolidated RMA and accepts sea leg AWB. We can extend the 40% expedite hold for 12h.

miguel_ops: If they cover 50% courier, total ~= €4,560. Ben, any flex? Product ops can top emergency to €4.8k with PM sign-off.

ben_fin: Product ops sign-off would be required for >€4.5k. I can approve up to €4.8k with PMOK. Rachel, can you confirm product?

rachel_sourcing: I'll ping product ops now. Meanwhile Anya, can you sketch the remap script and the manifest schema we need so we can insist on it in the RMA?

anya_sre: Yep. Minimal manifest CSV we require: old_serial,new_serial,action,leg,photo_url,hs_code. Example row:
old_serial,new_serial,action,leg,photo_url,hs_code
H100-AA12,H100-AA12,replace,air,https://img/pic1.jpg,85423100

anya_sre: Remap pseudo:
```
# remap incoming serial to existing node tag
# input: csv_manifest rows
for row in csv_manifest:
  if row.action == 'replace':
    remap_to_node(row.new_serial, lookup_old=row.old_serial)
  elif row.action == 'repair':
    mark_node_under_repair(row.old_serial)
```

claire_logistics: Also need HS/ECCN cert and an invoice copy at least 12h before flight for customs pre-clear. Forwarder won't pre-clear otherwise. Polar, can you attach those on signed RMA?

polar_bot: Polar Freight: Confirmed: will attach HS certificate, ECCN note (EAR99), and per-leg manifest on signed consolidated RMA. Holding 40% expedite + 50% courier cover for 12h.

rachel_sourcing: OK. Product ops said they're willing to approve up to €4.8k if we prepay and get manifest + HS docs. Ben, please keep payment gate open pending PMOK.

ben_fin: I'll provision payment hold. When manifest arrives, send invoice and PM approval. I'll release.

miguel_ops: Action list summary: 1) rachel_sourcing lock product ops and confirm PMOK, 2) polar_bot provide signed RMA + HS/cert + per-leg manifest, 3) anya_sre implement remap hook and reconciliation check, 4) claire_logistics prep courier pre-alert and customs packet if docs present. Holding decision window 12h.

rachel_sourcing: Thanks team — marking eu-west capacity at-risk in tracker and will update once payment + manifest are in. :white_check_mark:
